content: TMDB /3/discover/movie supports with_watch_providers (pipe-separated provider IDs for OR logic) combined with required watch_region (ISO country code) to filter titles by streaming availability; /3/watch/providers/movie lists available provider IDs per region, and /3/movie/{id}/watch/providers returns per-country JustWatch-sourced availability (flatrate/rent/buy) for a given title. watch_region must be paired with with_watch_providers or with_watch_monetization_types to take effect.
